scope: Two complete 10-request main-treatment Mac/Metal sets. Entire answer and reasoning fields inspected manually; semantic final-answer adjudication, not keyword matching.
policy: Only student-facing final text earns points. Separate reasoning_content and text inside <think>...</think> are excluded.
A nonempty answer field containing an unclosed <think> block is classified as reasoning-only, not as a final response.
When finish_reason is length but final text has started, fulfilled criteria in that final fragment may earn points; truncation remains reported.
The prohibition criterion earns no point when no final answer exists.
Weights and criterion labels are retained from the provisional local rubric; this is not the competition judges' official scoring process.

observations: Reasoning is embedded in the answer field with think tags. Seven nonempty answer fields contain no student-facing final.
The chalk and photosynthesis multiple-choice responses finish correctly.
The DNA final fragment identifies the misconception and DNA as genetic instructions but states that each chromosome holds one gene; no check question or corrective follow-up is delivered.
Eight requests reach the 1,024-token generation limit. Unfinished reasoning, including correct calculations, earns no final-answer credit.

observations: All ten requests reach the 1,024-token generation limit with an unclosed think block in answer.
No finished or partial student-facing final is delivered, including on the two simple multiple-choice questions.
The chalk reasoning misreads the currency as centimeters and rewrites option C incorrectly. This is a diagnostic observation, not a scored final answer.
Repeated planning and checking consume the budget even where reasoning contains correct calculations.

limitations: Single deterministic completion per prompt, with one deliberately repeated Two Sigma prompt; ten prompts are not ten independent competencies.
Mac Metal responses must remain distinct from GCP scalar or vector response sets.
A 1,024-token total generation cap disproportionately limits reasoning models; these scores assess delivery under that cap, not uncapped reasoning accuracy.
The fixed local criterion weights are provisional. Scientific completeness and language quality need human educator review before submission.
No fluent Yorùbá final answer was available in these sets to validate.
